summary: First-ever computation of the post-pushforward Frobenius spectra behind the hook-cohomology door. p=5: COMPLETE — all five L_i(T) = det(1-TF|H^1_c(U,V_i)) for every q in {1,3,4}, determined and out-of-sample validated through j=9. The even/odd cancellation is real and fully identified: everything weight-0 cancels except the single Kummer class chi(u_q(t^2-1)) (u_q = 3q(q-2)^2), and the weight-1 survivors are exactly H^1(pair curve B_q) on the even side minus H^1(genus-2 twist curve D_q: w^2 = u_q g_+ g_-) on the odd side — all verified by independent point counts. Exact formula: 5·I_j(q) = 5^j - [chi(u_q)^j + a_j(B_q) - a_j(D_q)]. Surviving rank 3 (q=1, where H^1(B_1) is an isogeny factor of Jac D_1) or 7 (= p+2) otherwise. p=7: L_0, L_1, L_6 exact; L_5 = (1∓T)^2·L(D_q) with D_q genus 4 (2 fitted params, 5-6 j validated); V_2 has a unique structured fit with a single elliptic weight-1 factor for all five q; V_3/V_4 candidates (weight-1 ranks 10, 12); unconditional Weil lower bound: surviving rank >= 14 at q=5. Scaling probe (p=5,7,11 E_j tables): rms-estimated surviving rank r ~= 4, 22, 40 tracks ~4p LINEARLY; the exponential Swan-total scenario (744 at p=11, would give rms 27 vs observed 6.3) is excluded — the door's O(p) collapse is empirically supported. Both epsilon-families are twist-readings of ONE surviving object per q (nonsplit = flip Kummer + flip exactly one D-factor; verified exactly at p=5). The q=2 boundary fiber is solved in closed form (extra Tate class; I_j = 2·5^{j-1} exactly at p=5), and is needed to close the CVN.2 reconstruction (verified: N_1(5)=4, N_2(5)=6).
writeup:
# Through the door: the surviving object of the hook ledger, computed (p = 5, 7; scaling to 11, 13)

All work in `frontier/hook_spectra_smallp/` in the worktree (scripts, raw exact censuses `cycle_counts_*.json`, `results_summary.json`). Method: for the normal-form cover P_{q,t}(z) = q z^p + z^3 - 3z - (q-2)t over U = P^1_t \ {±1,∞}, factor P_{q,t} over F_{p^j} for every t (python-flint fq_default), convert cycle types to e_i(Std-eigenvalues) via prod_d(1-(-t)^{d})/(1+t) (table verified symbolically AND against numpy permutation matrices), Lefschetz gives exact integer power sums P_j(i) = Tr(F^j|H^1_c(U,V_i)) = [i=0]p^j - T_j(V_i), Newton gives L_i(T) = det(1-TF|H^1_c) at the ledger dims h_i, with every remaining j an out-of-sample validation. Two independent code paths agree; all Newton char polys integral; the h_i of the (conditional) wild-inertia ledger are empirically CONFIRMED at p=5 (all hooks, all q, incl. dim-8 validated at j=9) — first empirical verification of the ledger dims.

## 1. p = 5 complete spectra (all validated through j = 9)

  q=1 (chi(q)=+1):  L0=(1-T)^2; L1=(1-T)^4(1+T)^2; L2=(1-T)^2(1+T)^4(1+5T^2); L3=(1+T)^2(1-4T+5T^2)(1+5T^2); L4=(1+T)
  q=3 (chi(q)=-1):  L0=(1-T)^2; L1=(1-T)^2 Φ3^2;   L2=(1-T)^2(1-2T+5T^2)Φ3^2; L3=(1-T)^2(1-T+5T^2)(1+3T+5T^2); L4=(1-T)
  q=4 (chi(q)=+1):  L0=(1-T)^2; L1=(1-T)^2 Φ3^2;   L2=(1-T)^2(1+2T+5T^2)Φ3^2; L3=(1-T)^2(1-3T+5T^2)(1+T+5T^2); L4=(1+T)

Even/odd cancellation (H_even = 11, H_odd = 12):
  q=1: survivors even (1+T), odd (1-4T+5T^2)                  — rank 3
  q=3: even (1-T)(1-2T+5T^2), odd (1-T+5T^2)(1+3T+5T^2)       — rank 7
  q=4: even (1+T)(1+2T+5T^2), odd (1-3T+5T^2)(1+T+5T^2)       — rank 7
Virtual rank -1 = 4-p in every case (ledger check). 23 dimensions collapse to ≤ 7 = p+2.

## 2. Identity of every constituent (p = 5, all verified by independent geometry)

* Weight 0. H^1_c(V_0⊕V_1) = reduced permutation module on the 9 punctures of the z-line (∞ + the two critical fibers (z∓1)^2·g_±(z), g_± the residual cubics); L_1 exactly matches the g_± factorizations. V_2, V_3 weight-0 parts are the same puncture data. V_4 = Kummer sheaf chi(u_q(t^2-1)) with disc_z P_{q,t} = u_q(t^2-1), u_q = 3q(q-2)^2 (resultant derivation + numerics; p=7: u_q = -3q^3(q-2)^2). **All weight-0 classes cancel except this one Kummer class** — the "q-Kummer factor" of the cold audit, eigenvalue chi(u_q) = -chi(q) at p=5, +chi(q) at p=7.
* Weight 1, odd. The rank-4 weight-1 part of L_3 is L(D_q), D_q: w^2 = u_q g_+(z)g_-(z) — genus 2, computed independently by point counts (`genus2_p5.py`), exact match for all q. Jac(D_q) ~ E_{a1} × E_{a2} (elliptic traces: q=1: {0,4}; q=3: {1,-3}; q=4: {3,-1}); at q=1 CM/supersingular (2±i in Z[i], ±i√5).
* Weight 1, even. The rank-2 weight-1 part of L_2 is the anti-invariant H^1 of the pair curve B_q: (P_q(z1)-P_q(z2))/(z1-z2) = 0 (its (s,m)-quotient is rational), computed independently (`pair_curve_p5.py`): traces a = 0, 2, -2 for q = 1, 3, 4 — again exact match.
* The q=1 rank drop 7→3 is an accidental isogeny H^1(B_1) ⊂ Jac(D_1) (both contain 1+5T^2); absent at q=3,4 and at 5 sampled generic q in F_25 (`generic_q_p5.py`, D_q L-polys j=3-validated).

**Exact count formula (verified all q, all j ≤ 9, re-verified through an independent trace pipeline):**
    5·I_j(q) = 5^j - E_j(q),   E_j(q) = chi(u_q)^j + a_j(B_q) - a_j(D_q).
E.g. q=1: 5·I_j = 5^j - (-1)^j + (2+i)^j + (2-i)^j. This is a prime-number-theorem with three explicit "zeros" for the fixed-q fiber problem.

## 3. p = 7 (census j ≤ 7 complete for all five q; j = 8 batch was mid-flight at session end — files land as cycle_counts_p7_j8_q*.json, with queued auto-analyses final_p7_analysis.txt / final_p7_fits.txt)

Ledger dims h = (2,10,23,32,23,10,1), H_even = 49, H_odd = 52. Exact results (validated on all computed j):
* L_0 = (1-T)^2; L_6 = 1 - chi(u_q)T (u_q = -3q^3(q-2)^2).
* L_1 = puncture module (13 punctures; critical fibers (z∓1)^2·quintic): q=1,6: (1-T)^2Φ5^2; q=3: (1-T)^6Φ3^2; q=4: (1-T)^4(1+T)^2Φ4^2; q=5: (1-T)^4(1+T)^2Φ3^2 — exact match to quintic factorizations.
* **L_5 = W0·L(D_q)** with W0 = (1-T)^2 (q=1,3,6) or (1+T)^2 (q=4,5) and D_q now genus 4 (g_± quintics), L(D_q) computed independently with functional equation + j=5 validation (`genus4_p7.py`); only 2 parameters fitted, 5-6 j's validated. So V_{p-2} = Std⊗sgn ↦ Jac of a genus-(p-3) curve persists.
* V_2: unique structured fit per q (cyclotomic weight-0 from puncture products + Weil part): weight-1 part is ALWAYS a single elliptic factor: 1+7T^2 (q=1), 1+2T+7T^2 (q=3), 1+3T+7T^2 (q=4), 1-3T+7T^2 (q=5), 1-2T+7T^2 (q=6); 6 validation j's each; the q=1 case independently confirmed by pair-curve/quotient-curve counts (which also fully reproduce all 7 census power sums, giving L_2(q=1) = (1-T)^5Φ5^4(1+7T^2)).
* V_3, V_4 candidates (functional-equation Newton fits, 1-2 validation j's — NOT settled): weight-1 ranks 10 and 12; q=1: W1(V_3) = (1+T-7T^2+7T^3+49T^4)(1+T-14T^3+49T^5+343T^6) — note the first factor is the T→-T twist of a Jac(D_1) factor; W1(V_4) contains (1+7T^2) (shared with V_2, same side, no cancellation).
* Cross-pipeline identity: the sgn-weighted pair-configuration count (independent geometric code) satisfies antichi_j = -P_j(V_4) - P_j(V_5) exactly (rep-theory: Λ^2(Perm)⊗sgn = V_4 ⊕ V_5) — a strong end-to-end check.
* Unconditional survivor bounds (Weil on E_j): surviving weight-1 rank ≥ 7, 11, 7, 14, 5 at q = 1, 3, 4, 5, 6. At j=1 the count structure is stark: q=1,6 have ZERO irreducible fibers over F_7 (E_1 = +p), q=3,4,5 have two — pointwise Weil is vacuous when r ~ p; positivity of N_a lives in the q-average.

## 4. Scaling of the surviving rank (the door's central question)

E_j tables for p=11 (j≤5, q≤5 computed) and p=13 (in flight) in `Ej_scaling.log` / `Ej_p11_p13.json`. rms(E_j/p^{j/2}) and implied surviving rank r ≈ rms^2:
    p=5:  rms 2.02 → r ≈ 4   (true 3-7)
    p=7:  rms 4.74 → r ≈ 22  (bounds 14..~33)
    p=11: rms 6.33 → r ≈ 40
Compare 4p = 20, 28, 44 (linear fit) vs Swan-total (p-3)(2^{p-1}-1)/p = 6, 36, 744. At p=11 the exponential scenario predicts rms ≈ 27; observed 6.3. **The exponential-to-linear collapse conjectured behind the door is empirically supported: the surviving object behaves like a rank ≈ 4p motive.** (Caveat: rms is a phase-equidistribution estimate; hard lower bounds are the Weil ones above.)

## 5. Both epsilon-families and the boundary

* Nonsplit (ε=-1) towers (X^p - (ηq)^{-1}X^3 + 3q^{-1}X + d over F_{p^j}): even-j counts equal the untwisted ones EXACTLY (forced); at p=5 the odd-j data has a unique rank-7 fit revealing the rule: **nonsplit = same surviving object with the Kummer class and exactly one Jac(D_q)-factor sign-flipped** (q=1: full global twist E^-_j = (-1)^j E_j; q=3: {+1; B:2; D:1,-3} → {-1; B:2; D:-1,-3}; q=4: {-1; B:-2; D:3,-1} → {+1; B:-2; D:3,1}). So n_+(q) and n_-(q) are two Frobenius readings of ONE object: p·n_±(q) = p ∓ (flip-adjusted E_1). At p=7 q=1 the readings complement: I_1 = 0 but I^-_1 = 2.
* q=2 boundary (colliding critical values; needed to close CVN.2): p=5 slice x(x^2+1)^2+d has sgn sheaf TRIVIAL → second Tate class → I_j = 2·5^{j-1} exactly; p=7: I_j = [2·7^j + 2Re(i√7)^j]/7 exactly. CVN.2 reconstruction closes: N_1(5) = 0+2+2+0 = 4 ✓, N_2(5) = 2+0+0+2+2 = 6 ✓ against the validation table, with n_+(q) = census I_1(q) exactly.

## 6. Conjecture (identity of the surviving object) and what it means for the crown

For every p ≥ 5, q ≠ 0,2,∞: after even/odd semisimplification the hook ledger collapses to
    S_q = [Kummer class chi(u_q(t^2-1))] ⊕ [H^1 of an explicit system of configuration curves of the cover],
where the curve system contains at least: the pair-curve anti-part (rank 2, from V_2), the sgn-twist curve D_q of genus p-3 (from V_{p-2}), and (p ≥ 7) higher k-configuration classes from the middle hooks (ranks ~10-12 at p=7); total rank ≈ 4p, versus raw dims ~2^{p-1} per side. The weight-0 sector cancels EXACTLY down to the single Kummer class (proved at p=5; consistent at p=7). The two universal ε-families read S_q with a sign character (flip of Kummer + one D-factor). The fixed-q crown count is then p·n_±(q) = p ∓ E_1(q) with E_1 a trace of S_q — so the crown (N_a = Σ_q n_± + boundary > 0) is equivalent to a bound on the q-AVERAGED traces of two explicit curve FAMILIES over the q-line (surfaces of degree O(p)), a polynomial-size Weil-II problem replacing the 2^p-dimensional sheaf bookkeeping. Pointwise Weil at j=1 is provably insufficient (E_1 = ±p occurs), so the q-line assembly is where the remaining content lives.

## 7. Files (all under frontier/hook_spectra_smallp/)
scan_generic.py (census engine), analyze_generic.py / analyze_p7.py (pipelines), fit_middle*_p7.py (structured fits), genus2_p5.py / genus4_p7.py (D_q), pair_curve_*.py / pair_twist_p7.py (B_q, sgn-twists), generic_q_p5.py (F_25 probe), analyze_q2slice.py, update_summary.py; data: cycle_counts_*.json (64 files), pair_curve_p5.json, pair_twist_p7.json, nonsplit_towers_p{5,7}.json, Ej_p11_p13.json (in flight; interim in Ej_scaling.log), results_summary.json (machine-readable summary of everything above).

key_claims.notes: exact integer census, two independent code paths agree, all coefficients integral, dim-8 hook validated at j=9 for every q; empirically confirms the conditional wild-inertia ledger dims at p=5

key_claims.claim: p=5 even/odd cancellation leaves survivors: q=1: (1+T) even vs (1-4T+5T^2) odd (rank 3); q=3: (1-T)(1-2T+5T^2) vs (1-T+5T^2)(1+3T+5T^2) (rank 7); q=4: (1+T)(1+2T+5T^2) vs (1-3T+5T^2)(1+T+5T^2) (rank 7); virtual rank -1 = 4-p in all cases

key_claims.notes: u_q formulas derived by resultant computation and verified numerically for all q at both primes; complete weight-0 cancellation proved at p=5 by the validated spectra; at p=7 exact for L_0,L_1,L_6 and consistent via candidates

key_claims.notes: independent point-count computations of both curves match the census spectra exactly for all q (exact finite verification; 'proved' as an identity of the computed L-factors at p=5)

key_claims.notes: verified twice through independent pipelines; gives |5 n_+(q) - 5| <= 1 + 6 sqrt(5) effective per-q bound at p=5

key_claims.notes: unique in a natural ansatz space with 6 out-of-sample j validations each; q=1 weight-1 factor independently confirmed by pair/quotient-curve point counts; dim 23 > jmax so not a Newton determination

key_claims.notes: functional-equation Newton fits with only 1-2 out-of-sample validations; j=8 census (in flight) adds one validation each; treat as candidates

key_claims.claim: p=7 surviving rank is >= 14 at q=5 (and >= 7,11,7,5 at q=1,3,4,6)
key_claims.notes: unconditional: |E_j| <= r0 + r1 7^{j/2} with E_6(q=5)=4669 exact; same method underestimates true rank at p=5 by ~1.7x

key_claims.notes: rms is a phase-equidistribution estimate, not a bound; but exact at p=5, bracketed at p=7, and the p=11 discrepancy vs exponential is a factor 4+ in rms (18x in rank); p=13 data in flight

key_claims.claim: The epsilon=-1 (nonsplit) family at parameter q is the same surviving object read through a sign character: Kummer class and exactly one Jac(D_q) factor flip; q=1 (p=5) is the full global twist E^-_j = (-1)^j E_j
key_claims.notes: p=5: unique rank-7 fits of the nonsplit towers (7 j-values, 3-4 dof) for q=3,4; q=1 exact identity; p=7: even-j forced equality verified for all q, odd-j consistent with partial flips but not yet fitted

key_claims.claim: The q=2 boundary fiber is solved: p=5: I_j = 2*5^{j-1} exactly (sgn sheaf trivial, second Tate class); p=7: I_j = [2*7^j + 2Re(i sqrt7)^j]/7 exactly
key_claims.notes: p=5 verified j<=8, p=7 verified j<=4; disc = unit*square at q=2 proved by direct computation

key_claims.claim: CVN.2 reconstruction closes at p=5 including the q=2 fiber: N_1(5) = 0+2+2+0 = 4, N_2(5) = 2+0+0+2+2 = 6, with n_+(q) equal to the census irreducible-t count I_1(q)
key_claims.notes: brute-force cross-check against the validation table; the q=2 term (previously overlooked in the q-sum) is required for N_2

key_claims.claim: Pointwise Weil bounds at j=1 cannot prove the crown: E_1(q) = +p occurs (p=7, q=1,6 have zero irreducible fibers over F_7)
key_claims.notes: exact census fact; positivity must come from the q-average / both-epsilon-readings (at p=7 q=1 the nonsplit reading has I^-_1 = 2 > 0)

best_next: Assemble the now-identified surviving objects into q-line families and prove the CVN.2 sums there: the two explicit families B = {pair curve B_q} and D = {w^2 = u_q g_{q,+} g_{q,-}} are surfaces of degree O(p) fibered over the q-line, and the crown sums S^0_± = p + O(sqrt p) reduce to bounding Tr F on H^1_c(q-line, R^1 pi_* Q_l) for these two families plus the exact Kummer/boundary terms — a polynomial-size Weil II conductor computation (conductor O(p) plausible from the three q-degenerations 0, 2, infinity already catalogued, with the q=2 fiber solved in closed form). Concretely: (1) compute the D-family monodromy/conductor over the q-line at p=5,7 numerically from the existing data plus a q-census of a_1(D_q) for all q (cheap), (2) verify S^0_± and S^chi_± against the exact per-q formula p·n_±(q) = p ∓ E_1(q), (3) then attempt the general-p statement. Secondary: finish the in-flight p=7 j=8 census (auto-analyses queued in the worktree) to settle the V_3/V_4 candidates, and extend the Ej scaling run to p=13 to pin r(p) ~ 4p.
